description: The crew walks the five-Knot science plan; a solar particle event alert on the way to Boxwork hollow, after the first samples, sends them back to the pressurised rover, the best shelter on the patch.

events.display_message: Marswalk started: five Knots planned, first stop Boxwork first view.
events.recommended_action: Follow the planned route and check tasks off at each Knot.

events.display_message: Solar storm: radiation rising fast. Shelter in the rover.
Rerouting to the rover; the science plan is paused.
events.recommended_action: Follow the route and enter the rover.
